name: What materials are used for drywall hole repair?

mainEntity.name: What materials are used for drywall hole repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The materials used depend on the size and type of hole. Common materials include drywall joint compound (mud), fiberglass mesh tape or paper tape for seams, drywall patches (self-adhesive or paper-faced), and new sections of drywall for larger repairs. We also use primers specifically designed for drywall to ensure proper paint adhesion and a uniform finish. High-quality tools like mud pans, taping knives, and sanding equipment are also essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Materials include joint compound, fiberglass mesh or paper tape, drywall patches, new drywall sections, and primers for paint adhesion.
